stem: Two source waters have nearly the same pH, but Source B has much higher alkalinity. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: They will behave identically over repeated irrigation.
Source B can deliver a larger acid-neutralizing load even though spot pH is similar.
Source A must have higher EC.
Alkalinity is another name for pH.
rationale: pH and alkalinity describe different properties; higher alkalinity can exert greater cumulative buffering influence.
